chapters.label: Le Classique
chapters.text: Marseille against Paris Saint-Germain, 2021. Seven minutes left, no goals. Messi slides a pass through. Kylian Mbappé is away! But William Saliba, on loan from Arsenal, races after him and slides in to win the ball!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Saliba uses his speed to catch up and run alongside. Then he slides in low, and takes the ball, not the player.

chapters.label: From behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: a perfect tackle. No goal for Mbappé!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: William Saliba, calm and fast. Use your speed to get goal-side first. Then take the ball calmly!
